set.body: Owner decision 2026-10-12 (density questions): S18 keeps the ramp and pins the measured contrasts; this mote proposes stage-aware density colours for the owner to approve. Measured by S17: ramp-0 at 0.6 opacity is 5.57:1 on the Dark stage, 2.25:1 on Mid (#767676), 1.09:1 on Light (#F2F2F2); over the frame's screen field (#9A9A96) ramp-1 is 1.10:1 and ramp-3 1.20:1 on Dark. Goal: every density level, singletons included, reaches 3:1 non-text contrast on every stage, as a token change with TokenContrastSuite pins. Epic bd-01M4R9BYCYAZAPHYSK79MVWHKW.
set.title: Propose stage-aware density colours so singletons read on Mid and Light stages
